gate: alpha=1/2 with constant-fraction pathwise complex rank deficit
theorem: For fixed C>0 and 0<delta<=1, every admissible independently seeded transcript-only adaptive complex-linear measurement scheme with terminal rank deficit d>=delta N has Gaussian-input endpoint success probability at most exp(-(delta/2)*exp(-8*C*C/delta)*N)+exp(-(3-log(4))*N).
uniformity: all measurable transcript-only adaptive query policies
almost-sure finite stopping times with no deterministic query-count bound
also countably infinite limiting transcripts, as proved in the optional extension
architecture_consequence: Applies when M=Theta(log N) and s is fixed, or more generally s/M<=1-gamma for a fixed gamma>0.
excluded_claims: endpoint theorem for d asymptotic to N/log N
endpoint theorem for arbitrary nonzero rank deficiency
uncharged raw-input or other side channels
